item.text: {"ticker":"ASML","status":"success","report":"This report is for educational use only and is not financial advice. MCP returned a successful FCFF valuation in EUR with an estimated value per share of 924.22 versus a market price of 1408.28. Growth assumptions are high early: revenue growth is 21.24% in year 1, 16.95% for years 2-5, then fades toward 2.43% terminal growth. Margins start from a 36.60% base operating margin, move to 37.00% next year, and converge to a 31.17% target margin. Reinvestment is modeled through sales-to-capital: 2.22x in years 1-5, 1.33x in years 6-10, and terminal reinvestment of 33.75%, which means future growth requires meaningful capital support. Cost of capital starts at 9.58% and fades to 7.20% terminal, using a 2.43% risk-free rate and configured Damodaran ERP inputs. Terminal value is 670.59B EUR, with present value of terminal value at 187.61B EUR, a large share of the total 350.54B EUR operating asset value. Data caveats: market data came through Yahoo Finance via the local yfinance service and may be missing, stale, or insufficient; Damodaran reference data mapped ASML to Global Semiconductor Equip with high confidence, but the service version and model/data versions were null."}
